# # getOwnerHQ

> getOwnerHQ is a Multi-tenant SaaS platform built for Indian gym owners, fitness studios, MMA clubs & academies.

## Features
- Gym Member self-registrations via QR Code
- Dashboard for tracking expiring memberships
- Manual WhatsApp reminders & templates
- Payments Ledger & financial tracking
- Membership plans management
- Billing & subscription management
- Settings & gym profile management
- A5 QR Standee printing

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Backend/Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL) with RLS
- Payments: Cashfree (subscriptions, webhooks)
- Deployment: Vercel/Netlify compatible

## API Endpoints
- `/api/verify-cashfree-session` - Verify Cashfree subscription status
- `/api/cashfree-return` - Cashfree webhook return handler
